question: In 2023 many UK phone contracts rose by inflation plus 3.9%. With inflation at 10.5%, what did a £20 monthly bill become?
answer: £22.88 a month, 14.4% more. Ofcom banned inflation-linked rises in new contracts from January 2025: rises must now be set out in pounds and pence.
move: Turn every percentage rise into pounds before agreeing to it.
ask: Which contract of mine rises by a formula I have never turned into pounds?
hint: Add the 3.9 points to inflation first, then apply the total rise.
steps: £2.88 more a month: £34.56 more over the year.
source: Choose, Ofcom bans inflation-linked mid-contract price rises, 2024
